about.headline: Bridging Offensive Security Awareness with Resilient Digital Craftsmanship
about.summary: I am MD Ahammed, founder of ECHO Cybersecurity & Digital Services. My work focuses on helping individuals, creators, and growing businesses protect their web presence, recover compromised assets, and launch clean, reliable digital platforms.
about.background: With hands-on experience across web development, server environments, WordPress ecosystems, and security auditing, I approach every project with an attacker-informed defensive mindset. Whether auditing a web application for vulnerabilities, cleaning malware, or building a high-converting site from scratch, clarity and technical precision remain my top priorities.
about.goals: My goal is to make practical cybersecurity hygiene, structured OSINT research, and dependable digital execution accessible to businesses and professionals without unnecessary complexity or empty promises.

posts.title: Welcome to ECHO Cybersecurity & Digital Services
posts.description: Welcome to my official portfolio and digital services hub. Here I share technical updates, security insights, web development showcases, and service announcements. Click 'MD' in the top-left header anytime to open the Admin Panel and manage all site content via master.json.

posts.title: Web Application Security & WordPress Hardening Checklist
posts.description: A structured approach to securing modern web properties: principle of least privilege, strict input validation, HTTP security headers, file integrity monitoring, and proactive vulnerability assessments before deployment.

services.title: Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT)
services.description: Systematic identification and verification of security weaknesses across web applications and digital assets with actionable remediation guidance.
services.details: Includes passive and active reconnaissance, manual OWASP Top 10 verification, business logic testing, CVSS severity scoring, and a step-by-step developer remediation guide.

services.title: Professional Website Security
services.description: Comprehensive protection setup including firewall configuration, SSL/TLS enforcement, secure headers, and continuous hardening best practices.
services.details: Covers Cloudflare/WAF rule tuning, HTTPS/HSTS enforcement, Content-Security-Policy & X-Frame-Options headers, and server hardening.

services.title: WordPress Malware Removal
services.description: Thorough inspection and cleanup of infected WordPress core files, themes, plugins, and databases to restore clean site operation.
services.details: Full file-by-file core integrity verification, obfuscated PHP backdoor cleanup, database injection scrubbing, and post-recovery firewall setup.

services.title: Recover Hacked Websites
services.description: Incident response assistance to regain control of compromised websites, patch exploited entry points, and assist with blacklist review requests.
services.details: Rapid containment of defaced or blacklisted websites, credential rotation, vulnerability patching, and Google Safe Browsing reconsideration support.

services.title: WordPress Security Hardening
services.description: Locking down administrative endpoints, file permissions, login security, and plugin configurations to reduce attack surface.
services.details: Secures wp-config.php, disables XML-RPC/file editing, enforces strong 2FA authentication, and applies least-privilege directory permissions.

services.title: OSINT and Digital Exposure Intelligence
services.description: Ethical open-source intelligence assessment to discover publicly exposed metadata, leaked credentials, and digital footprint risks.
services.details: Maps exposed subdomains, public repositories, breach exposure indicators, and metadata leaks with actionable privacy mitigation steps.

services.title: Security Auditing
services.description: In-depth configuration and architecture review of websites, hosting panels, and digital workflows against security standards.
services.details: Holistic audit of DNS, SSL/TLS ciphers, hosting access controls, CMS plugins, and operational security posture.

services.title: Website Design and Development
services.description: Modern, fast, mobile-first websites and portfolios engineered with clean HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, or CMS platforms.
services.details: Custom responsive frontend and CMS builds engineered for fast Core Web Vitals, clean semantic HTML, dark/light theme support, and SEO readiness.

services.title: Web Hosting Assistance
services.description: Guidance and technical setup for domain configuration, DNS records, SSL certificates, migrations, and hosting optimization.
services.details: End-to-end cPanel/VPS setup, domain & DNS routing (A, CNAME, MX, SPF/DKIM), zero-downtime migrations, and SSL activation.

services.title: Social Account Recovery Assistance
services.description: Step-by-step technical guidance and official appeal preparation to help recover compromised or locked social media accounts.
services.details: Structured recovery checklist, identity verification preparation, official platform appeal formatting, and post-recovery 2FA lockdown.

services.title: Meta Verification Assistance
services.description: Eligibility review, profile readiness checklist, and documentation preparation support for Meta verification applications.
services.details: Evaluates notability, profile completeness, two-factor security, and official documentation requirements prior to submission.

services.title: Business Advertising
services.description: Structured digital ad campaign setup, audience targeting, and creative presentation to help businesses reach relevant customers.
services.details: Sets up Meta and search ad funnels, audience segmentation, conversion tracking pixels, and high-clarity ad visuals.

services.title: Microsoft Word & Excel
services.description: Professional document formatting, structured spreadsheets, formulas, reports, and clean business templates.
services.details: Creates executive Word reports, automated Excel trackers with formulas/charts, and standardized business documentation.

services.title: Photo & Video Editing
services.description: Clean visual retouching, background refinement, social media graphics, and engaging short-form or promotional video edits.
services.details: Delivers portrait retouching, social media promotional graphics, clean color grading, and crisp short-form video cuts.

services.title: Logo & Advertisement Design
services.description: Distinctive brand marks and high-clarity promotional banners crafted for digital platforms and print materials.
services.details: Designs memorable brand emblems, social banners, and marketing creatives in high-resolution web and print formats.

services.title: PDF to Word & Excel Conversion
services.description: Accurate conversion of static PDF files into clean, editable Word documents and structured Excel spreadsheets.
services.details: Preserves tables, typography, and multi-column formatting when converting PDFs into editable DOCX and XLSX files.

services.title: Virtual Assistant, Research & Data Entry
services.description: Reliable online research, structured data entry, email management, and day-to-day administrative support.
services.details: Provides structured web research, CRM/spreadsheet data entry, inbox triage, and ongoing operational support.
